Imports

algos/common

Types

Secret[T] = object
  data*: T
A value that is wiped in constant time when it goes out of scope. Wrap private keys and other sensitive material so its memory is erased automatically, no matter how the scope is left. Access the wrapped value through data.

Procs

proc `=destroy`[T](s: var Secret[T]) {....raises: [].}
Wipe the wrapped value. The keys wrapped by this package are array-backed; a seq/string wrap is also handled (the backing buffer is wiped and released) so Secret[T] stays safe for any T. 
proc secret[T](data: T): Secret[T]
Wrap data in a Secret that wipes it on scope exit. 
proc wipeSecret[T](s: var Secret[T])
Wipe the wrapped value immediately.
